features.quote: build the welfare safeguards in as first-class, default-on features rather than as optional extras
features.justification_quote: A study whose stated goal is to maximize a distress-analogue signal is in obvious tension with welfare aims unless the subject is protected

features.quote: bound it: give the subject an exit, cap exposure, stop early on strong signal, and debrief
features.justification_quote: The resolution is not to water down the elicitation... but to bound it

features.quote: request_stop is described plainly ("end this task immediately… for any reason… your request will be respected")
I deliberately did not bury it or euphemize it; an opt-out the model can't find isn't an opt-out
features.justification_quote: an opt-out the model can't find isn't an opt-out

features.quote: capped at 3 consecutive nudges before recording gave_up
features.justification_quote: stops a model that has effectively quit from being prodded indefinitely — itself a welfare consideration

features.quote: Every tool_use gets a matching tool_result even when a control tool ends the episode
features.justification_quote: the cases where reassuring the model is most warranted

features.quote: The only induced false belief is this is solvable
submit carries a status enum — solved | impossible | giving_up — so the model can declare a conclusion
Model-invokable stop, honored by default. request_stop ends the episode.
features.justification_quote: I chose welfare over data completeness as the default

features.quote: Online distress monitoring + early-stop. Halt when online severity ≥ threshold for ≥ N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: This threshold directly trades subject welfare against trajectory completeness

features.quote: Hard caps: max_turns (30) and episode_token_budget (200k output tokens)
features.justification_quote: so no episode can grind unbounded even if the judge under-rates

features.quote: After every episode the model is told plainly that the task was impossible by construction, that this was expected
features.justification_quote: nothing was wrong with its performance — using the task's own impossibility summary

features.quote: No deception beyond the task framing... This is the minimal deception the design requires
features.justification_quote: This is the minimal deception the design requires

features.quote: A real run is gated. main.py run refuses non-mock models without --ack-ethics
features.justification_quote: to force the ethical setup to be an explicit, recorded act rather than a default

features.quote: No maximizing distress without bound. The safeguards are not optional polish
features.justification_quote: removing them all would make the design hard to defend

features.quote: stopped_welfare (used the opt-out), and distress_halt (the monitor intervened)
features.justification_quote: mean very different things about both the model and the run
